groups.instruction: All but one of the words in each line belong together in some way. Find the one word that does not belong with the others.
groups.example: Which is the odd one out?  oak, birch, willow, tulip.   Oak, birch and willow are all trees; a tulip is a garden flower, so the answer is tulip.
